meta.title: Mobility — Mobil Industrial & Fleet Lubricants in Egypt
meta.description: Your authorized Mobil distributor in Egypt. Industrial and fleet lubricants backed by local stock, field engineering, oil analysis, and practical lubrication support.

hero.imageAlt: Technician handling Mobil 1 oil in a workshop
hero.lead: More than just oils. We provide total engineering solutions!
hero.body: As a trusted official Mobil distributor, we deliver 100% authentic industrial lubrication, unmatched local warehousing, and expert technical support to keep your operations running seamlessly.
hero.supportLine: Supporting industrial and fleet operators in 10th of Ramadan, Obour, and across Egypt.
hero.note: Technical support from product selection to condition monitoring

panel.title: One partner.
panel.body: Industrial, fleet, and marine lubricants backed by local stock and practical field expertise.

why.titlePrefix: A distributor that acts like part of
why.description: Product access is only the start. We combine local inventory, logistics, and lubrication engineering so you can specify with confidence and keep equipment productive.

cards.title: Local stock, protected product
cards.description: Dedicated storage and careful handling keep lubricants in condition from our warehouse to your line.

cards.title: Alexandria logistics
cards.description: Amreya and Borg El Arab place inventory close to the port and the Delta's industrial corridor.

cards.title: Commercial flexibility
cards.description: Pricing, payment terms, and invoicing arrangements discussed around the needs of your account.

cards.title: Dispatch across hubs
cards.description: Stock points in 10th of Ramadan, Borg El Arab, Amreya, and Obour support planned, reliable dispatch.

products.description: Industrial and commercial-vehicle portfolios for defined applications. Our team helps you confirm the right grade, packaging, and current availability before you order.
products.note: Product availability varies by hub. Confirm grades, packaging, and current stock with our team.

industrial.name: Mobil DTE 20 Series
industrial.description: Anti-wear hydraulic oils for high-pressure systems, precision machinery, and equipment that depends on clean, reliable hydraulic performance.

industrial.name: Mobilgear 600 XP Series
industrial.description: Industrial gear oils formulated for enclosed gear drives operating under heavy loads and demanding industrial conditions.

fleet.name: Mobil Delvac MX 20W-50
fleet.description: Heavy-duty diesel engine oil for mixed fleets and older engines working in tough on-road and off-road conditions.

fleet.name: Mobil Delvac 1350
fleet.description: A dependable heavy-duty diesel engine oil for demanding commercial service and high-load operating cycles.

fleet.name: Mobil Delvac Modern 15W-40
fleet.description: Engine oil for modern diesel fleets and contemporary equipment, supported by our team's application guidance.

services.description: Specialist engineering, oil analysis, optimization, and filtration services help protect equipment and improve lubrication performance.

items.title: Mobil Serv℠ Oil Analysis
items.description: Advanced, programmatic laboratory testing of your equipment’s used oil to diagnose internal wear and predict potential mechanical failures before they cause costly breakdowns, supporting predictive maintenance.

items.title: On-Site Field Engineering Services (FES) & Site Surveys
items.description: Regular, scheduled visits by certified Lubrication Engineers (DLEs) to audit your facility, review machine applications, and recommend the optimal lubricant for every asset.

items.title: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Optimization
items.description: Tailored programs designed to extend oil drain intervals, reduce overall lubricant consumption, and maximize your plant’s financial efficiency.

items.title: Industrial Oil Filtration Services
items.description: Specialized on-site filtration solutions to purify in-service oils, remove contaminants, and drastically extend the operational lifespan of your machinery.

coverage.description: Our logistics hubs support industrial zones and free zones from Alexandria through the Delta and Greater Cairo. Tell us where you operate and we'll confirm product availability and delivery scope.

marine.title: Marine & free-zone supply
marine.description: Marine operators and free-zone businesses can contact our team to confirm supply access and technical fit for their location.
